# Dev CE test sets (generated by make_sets.py)

Each set is a list of C++ functions the bridge generator can expose (scalar arguments, resolvable `this`, no name collision). Getters and checks are included
so that void mutators have a readback. **Nothing here has been read or tested**: names and signatures come from the Linux debug symbols, the meaning is unknown.
Build with `python dev-ce/tools/gen_bridge.py --include <set>[,<set>...]` (the base build is the 350 ranked candidates).

| set | interfaces | functions | mutators | getters/checks | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| set_b_influence | IPlayerInfluence | 31 | 14 | 17 | envoy tokens, suzerain, levy, open borders: readbacks for the 16 mutators already in the base build |
| set_c_diplomacy | IPlayerDiplomacy, IGameDiplomacy, IDeal, IDealItem | 65 | 29 | 36 | war weariness, grievances, pending actions, open borders, deals |
| set_d_culture_religion | IPlayerCulture, IPlayerReligion, IPlayerStats, IPlayerGreatPeoplePoints, IGameReligion, IPlayerEras | 125 | 41 | 84 | civics/policies, pantheons/beliefs, score statistics |
| set_e_city | ICity, ICityBuildQueue, ICityBuildings, ICityGrowth, ICityCitizens, ICityReligion, ICityDistricts, IDistrict | 181 | 44 | 137 | production queue, growth, citizens, buildings |
| set_f_player | IPlayer, IPlayerUnits, IPlayerResources, IPlayerTreasury, IPlayerTechs, IPlayerTrade, IPlayerCities, IPlayerGovernors, IPlayerWMDs | 136 | 69 | 67 | player-wide switches, resources, treasury, techs, trade slots |
| set_g_world | IGame, IGameEras, IGameGreatPeople, IGameFalloutManager, IMap, IMapPlot, IMapTerritory, IMapAreaPortal, ITradeManager, IBarbarianTribes, IFreeCities | 172 | 44 | 128 | global game state, eras, climate/fallout, barbarians, trade manager |
| set_h_unit | IUnit, IUnitExperience, IUnitGreatPerson, IUnitReligion | 32 | 11 | 21 | unit state, experience, great person, religion |
| set_i_eras | IGameEras, IPlayerEras | 26 | - | - | hand-written: the Eras transition/commemoration functions decompiled on 2026-10-06 (findings/topics/eras-transition-and-commemorations.md) |

Not in any set (0): none
